title: Make a Difference: Proclaim the King
video_title: MAKE A DIFFERENCE_Proclaim The King: Joel Dombrow | Series: FIT FOR THE KING
speaker: Joel Dombrow
summary: Closing the Fit for the King series, Joel asks how we make a difference by proclaiming the King. Creation, praise, rescue from trials and rescue from sin all exist to make God known, as David's psalms show. Those who know Jesus must tell others, not keep faith private. Katie Taylor's worship-filled ring walk shows boldness. He urges us to find personal and church-wide ways to make Christ known, wherever we are.
highlights: All creation exists to make the King of heaven known.
All praise is to make the King of heaven known.
All deliverance from trouble and trials is to make the King of heaven known.
All deliverance from sin and darkness is to make the King of heaven known.
All who know the King of heaven are to make the King of heaven known.

takeaways.text: Ask what you personally can do to make the King of heaven known at work, school and home.
Keep inviting and praying for friends, and don't settle for church as it is.
Praise God out loud and sing, letting your worship encourage those around you.
Tell friends how God healed, rescued or provided for you in a hard season.
Share your story of being rescued from sin, including the ugly parts, to point others to God.

reflection_question.text: What can you do, and what can we do together, to make the King of heaven known to the world?
